'''Reesarians''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] from the [[Reesaria system]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Possessing almost [[Primate|simian]] features,<ref name="Path of Vengeance">''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]''</ref> they had acute senses and sharp [[eye]]sight that allowed them to see in [[infrared]] and [[ultraviolet]]. When a pair of Reesarians bonded, they became highly attuned to each other's whereabouts.<ref name="TROS VD" /> [[Ort (Reesarian)|Ort]] was a crimson-skinned Reesarian with long, plaited [[hair]] who served the [[Path of the Open Hand]] in the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="Path of Vengeance" /> [[Phenlass Sur|Phenlass]] and [[Odla Sur]] were a pair of bonded Reesarians who joined the [[Resistance]] as [[soldier]]s and [[scout]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" />
